wo-jpfa-JR5473.d:
Melakukan operasi gudang harian termasuk penerimaan, penyimpanan, pengambilan, pengemasan, dan pengiriman. Menangani material, produk, dan inventaris secara akurat dan aman. Mengikuti SOP gudang, standar keselamatan, kualitas, dan kebersihan. Mengoperasikan peralatan dan sistem gudang dasar sesuai kebutuhan. Mendukung akurasi inventaris melalui pelabelan dan pergerakan stok yang tepat. Membantu dalam penghitungan stok dan pengecekan inventaris. Melaporkan masalah operasional, kerusakan, atau masalah keselamatan kepada supervisor. Mendukung target produktivitas dan inisiatif peningkatan berkelanjutan.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
